name: Juliana
source:
An eighth-rank Angel who serves at the vanguard of the Angelic forces. Like all Angels, she despises Demons who bring chaos to the world and will annihilate any demons she faces without hesitation. 

[Spoiler] She is initially fooled by Klaus's appearance and assumes Klaus is a thrall under Helmina's control. Despite Helmina's repeated attempts to dissuade her, she does not listen. Klaus uses this to his advantage in their first battle. 

If she is captured in battle, Klaus uses sex magic to bind her under his control. Her devotion to duty is twisted from its original purpose and redirected towards serving Klaus. 

If she is present in the final battle, she will ask if the God the angels served really intended for the mass production to take place. [/Spoiler]
